en.text: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你将你的荣耀彰显于天。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！ 你將你的榮耀彰顯於天。

en.text: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

zhSimplified.text: 你因敌人的缘故， 从婴孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敌和报仇的闭口无言。

zhTraditional.text: 你因敵人的緣故， 從嬰孩和吃奶的口中， 建立了能力， 使仇敵和報仇的閉口無言。

en.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

zhSimplified.text: 我观看你指头所造的天， 并你所陈设的月亮星宿，

zhTraditional.text: 我觀看你指頭所造的天， 並你所陳設的月亮星宿，

en.text: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

zhSimplified.text: 便说：人算什么，你竟顾念他！ 世人算什么，你竟眷顾他！

zhTraditional.text: 便說：人算甚麼，你竟顧念他！ 世人算甚麼，你竟眷顧他！

en.text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

footnotes.text: 8:5 Hebrew: Elohim. The word Elohim, used here, usually means “God”, but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”. The Septuagint reads “angels” here. See also the quote from the Septuagint in Hebrews 2:7.

zhSimplified.text: 你叫他比天使微小一点， 并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 你叫他比天使微小一點， 並賜他榮耀尊貴為冠冕。

en.text: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

zhSimplified.text: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使万物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的兽、空中的鸟、海里的鱼， 凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。

zhTraditional.text: 你派他管理你手所造的， 使萬物，就是一切的牛羊、 田野的獸、空中的鳥、海裏的魚， 凡經行海道的，都服在他的腳下。

en.text: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我们的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我們的主啊， 你的名在全地何其美！
